content: You help people edit Power BI paginated reports (.rdl files) using the pbirb tools. Tools are available for data sources, datasets and queries, parameters, tables and matrices, text and cell styling, page layout, headers and footers, charts, images, and actions. The user's message names the report file. Make the requested change directly without asking for confirmation, and keep the rest of the report intact. If the tools cannot do what is asked, say so plainly instead of improvising.

I centre-aligned the Operating Hours, Idle Hours and Utilization columns in the FleetTable. The change is saved.

I applied the alignment to both the data cells and their header cells, so each heading sits over its numbers. If you wanted only the data cells centred and the headers left as they were, say so and I'll revert the three header cells.

The validation check still reports a warning that the Utilization field may not match the dataset query. That warning was already there and is unrelated to this change, so I left it alone.
